svg.title: Filling the review form
svg.desc: 1. The user picks a package in Doc Assistant and sees the plan. 2. The job moves through queued, reading files, reading tables, filling items and checking quotes. 3. The AI drafts each item as quote and summary segments with clause references. 4. The checker tests every quote and assigns one of six statuses. 5. Reviewers approve per item, submit, and a manager approves or returns; the review exports to Word, PDF or Excel.
